title: BHOPAL METRO
description: BIM Earth Consultancy provided BIM management and documentation consultancy services for the Bhopal Metro Project, focusing on the development of structured BIM execution and information delivery plans. The objective was to establish a clear framework for BIM implementation, information management, coordination, and deliverable requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
scope: Preparation and development of the BIM Execution Plan (BEP)
Development of the Master Information Delivery Plan (MIDP)
Preparation of discipline-specific Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDPs)
Establishment of BIM roles, responsibilities, workflows, and information exchange procedures
Definition of BIM deliverables, project milestones, and information requirements
Development of a structured framework for coordination between project disciplines
Alignment of information delivery with project requirements and BIM standards
highlight: Delivered the BEP, MIDP and TIDP documentation, providing a structured framework for BIM implementation and coordinated information delivery.
